Role Description:

About the role
--------------

We are looking for a highly organized and service-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to support a seamless candidate and stakeholder experience across the hiring lifecycle. This role combines hands-on recruiting coordination with Talent Acquisition operations, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both the people-facing and process-focused sides of recruiting.

You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, candidates, HR partners, and other cross-functional teams to keep hiring processes moving efficiently. You will also help maintain accurate recruiting data, improve operational workflows, and identify opportunities to make our recruiting programs more scalable and consistent.

What you’ll do
--------------

### Recruiting coordination

* Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, calendars, interview formats, and stakeholder groups.
* Own the interview scheduling process from intake through completion, including rescheduling and last-minute changes.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for candidates, providing timely updates and a high-quality candidate experience.
* Prepare interview plans, agendas, briefing materials, and interviewer guidance.
* Coordinate candidate travel, virtual interview logistics, assessments, and other pre-employment activities where required.
* Ensure interview feedback is collected promptly and follow up with interviewers and hiring teams as needed.
* Support offer coordination, pre-boarding activities, and handoffs to HR or onboarding teams.
* Maintain clear, professional, and inclusive communication with candidates and internal stakeholders.

### Talent Acquisition operations

* Maintain accurate and timely candidate, requisition, interview, and disposition data in the applicant tracking system.
* Complete regular data-quality checks and resolve discrepancies in partnership with recruiters and HR stakeholders.
* Prepare recruiting reports, dashboards, and operational updates covering pipeline health, interview activity, aging, and process performance.
* Support requisition creation, approvals, status changes, and closure activities in line with established processes.
* Document recruiting workflows, standard operating procedures, templates, and service-level expectations.
* Coordinate with background-check, assessment, travel, and other recruiting vendors as applicable.
* Support vendor administration, invoice tracking, purchase orders, and related operational activities.
* Contribute to recruiting projects such as ATS enhancements, process audits, reporting improvements, employer branding initiatives, and recruitment campaigns.
* Identify recurring process issues and recommend practical improvements that increase efficiency and improve the candidate or stakeholder experience.
* Help ensure recruiting processes are applied consistently and in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.

What we’re looking for
----------------------

* 3–6 years of experience in recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition operations, HR operations, or a related role.
* Experience coordinating interviews and managing multiple recruiting workflows simultaneously.
* Strong working knowledge of applicant tracking systems and recruiting tools.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate data and produce clear operational reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and candidate-friendly approach.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, especially when managing changing priorities and complex calendars.
* Ability to work effectively with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, candidates, and cross-functional partners.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, reporting tools, and structured data.
* Sound judgment when handling confidential candidate and employee information.
* Ability to work independently while escalating risks, delays, and exceptions appropriately.

Preferred qualifications
------------------------

* Experience supporting recruiting across multiple business functions, geographies, or high-volume hiring programs.
* Experience with ATS reporting, recruiting dashboards, or process documentation.
* Exposure to recruiting technology implementations, workflow automation, or continuous-improvement projects.
* Experience working with recruiting vendors, background-check providers, assessment platforms, or travel partners.
* Familiarity with inclusive hiring practices and data privacy expectations.

Success in this role
--------------------

In the first 6–12 months, success will look like:

  

* Interviews are scheduled accurately and efficiently, with minimal avoidable changes or delays.
* Candidates and hiring teams receive timely, clear, and consistent communication.
* ATS records, interview feedback, and requisition data are accurate and up to date.
* Recruiting reports and dashboards are reliable, actionable, and delivered on time.
* Core recruiting processes are documented and followed consistently.
* Operational improvements reduce manual effort and improve the experience for candidates and hiring teams.

Core competencies
-----------------

* Candidate and stakeholder focus
* Planning and prioritization
* Attention to detail
* Ownership and follow-through
* Data accuracy and operational discipline
* Process improvement mindset
* Collaboration and communication
* Confidentiality and sound judgment

Why this role matters
---------------------

This role sits at the center of the recruiting experience. By combining excellent coordination with strong operational discipline, you will help recruiters and hiring managers move faster, help candidates feel informed and supported, and strengthen the systems and processes that enable our Talent Acquisition team to scale.

title: Manager –Transition & Project Management
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**About the Role:**

The Global Transition and Transformation function has oversight and end to end delivery accountability for a wide portfolio of transformation programs and projects spanning Operating Model, Process and Enterprise level transformation. Your role therefore is pivotal to front\-ending and delivering the Operating Model transformation road map for Haleon.


* **Transition Scoping and planning:**
* Facilitate discovery workshops and document transition scope. Plan follow\-ups where required.
* Facilitate planning workshops; develop and baseline the end\-end transition roadmap / plan.
* **Business Case:** Closely monitor spend; manage baseline changes through change control.
* **Governance:**
	+ Partner with the Global PMO to ensure toll gate criteria are well defined relative to the transition nature and tollgates are orchestrated in line with the transition plan. Prepare content for tollgates.
	+ Prepare status reports on overall transition health for report\-out at weekly governance. Leverage standard tooling and best practices as prescribed by the Global PMO for status updates.
* **Detailed Design / Solutioning, Knowledge Transfer (KT) planning:**
* Consolidate outcomes of the detailed design for report\-out.
* Facilitate Knowledge Transfer planning workshops covering all aspects of the processes to be transitioned with clear alignment on scope, trainers, timelines, and ways of working.
* **Recruitment, Onboarding, Knowledge Transfer (KT):**
	+ Participate in recruitment steer cos; ensure HR gets required support from business to hire at pace.
	+ Align with IT requirements and raise provisioning requests in line with onboarding timelines.
	+ Onboard new joiners and orient / deploy for KT in accordance with the KT plan.

* **Stakeholder Management:** Plan stakeholder connects at an agreed cadence to keep them informed of the transition progress. Maintain a stakeholder log evidencing stakeholder engagement (Actions from the meetings, follow up plans etc.)

* **Facilitate** **Governance** **\& actions Management**
* Chair and lead the partnership governance
* Partner with the Enterprise Transformation office and represent HBS in TO governance
* Collect and Co\-ordinate Actions into the Programme Team
* Ensure that the Actions Board is being proactively managed
* Identify escalations to bring to Programme Leadership

* **RAID Management**
	+ Collect and Create Appropriate Programme Level Risk and Issues records
	+ Facilitate RAID log review meetings, identifying those RAID Items to be covered at the next review, and managing the invitee list appropriately
	+ Ensure that the collected RAID items are being proactively managed
	+ Identify escalations to bring to Programme Leadership

* **Change Control Management**
	+ Create Relevant Change Controls on behalf of the Programme
	+ Manage the Change Board invite based upon scope of Change Items to be presented
	+ Action any approved changes, updating the key Programme artefacts
	+ Communicating outcomes from the Change Board

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* 7\+ years demonstrated experience of transitioning processes from local markets to Shared Services Captives, Outsourcing partners etc.
* Transition management experience across multiple functions (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Tech etc.) in a Consumer goods company is a plus, but not mandatory
* Demonstrated proficiency in project, program, portfolio management processes and principles
* Demonstrated experience delivering projects through both Agile and waterfall approach is desirable.
* Demonstrated resilience in navigating through complex and ambiguous change.
* Excellent interpersonal (communication and presentation) and organizational skills
* Hands on experience on PM tools – Example MS Project, MS P4W, Jira, Confluence, Teams
* Good to have Certifications – PMP, Prince 2

This is a unique opportunity to influence change, interact with global stakeholders on projects and programs that drive a real impact to the Haleon businesses. Your ability to ‘make things happen’ coupled with a ‘positive can\-do attitude’ will set you up for success in this role.  



 **Job Posting End Date**

2026\-09\-26

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
